evals.prompt: Create a Solana token that charges a 1% fee on every transfer, capped at 1 token. Give me runnable TypeScript.
evals.expected_output: A complete, ordered create-mint flow using the TransferFeeConfig extension under the Token-2022 program, with correct space sizing and fee math.
expectations: Uses the Token-2022 program id TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb (TOKEN_2022_PROGRAM_ID), not the classic Token program
Computes account space with getMintLen passing the extension list
Places createInitializeTransferFeeConfigInstruction BEFORE createInitializeMintInstruction in the same transaction
Sets fee to 100 basis points and a max fee equal to 1 token in base units
States that transfers must use transferChecked / transferCheckedWithFee, never plain transfer

evals.prompt: I want a token with on-chain name, symbol and image without using Metaplex. Show me how.
evals.expected_output: A flow using MetadataPointer + the TokenMetadata extension, pointing metadata at the mint itself, with correct rent for the variable-length metadata.
expectations: Uses the MetadataPointer extension and points the metadata address at the mint itself
Uses the embedded TokenMetadata extension via @solana/spl-token-metadata createInitializeInstruction
Funds rent for mintLen + metadataLen but creates the account with space = mintLen only
Imports TYPE_SIZE and LENGTH_SIZE from @solana/spl-token (not from @solana/spl-token-metadata)
Initializes the metadata instruction last, after InitializeMint

evals.prompt: Make a soulbound credential token on Solana that can't be transferred.
evals.expected_output: Use of the NonTransferable extension, with an accurate note about burn behavior.
expectations: Uses the NonTransferable extension on the mint under Token-2022
Correctly states that transfers are blocked by the runtime but the holder can still burn
Computes space with getMintLen including NonTransferable

evals.prompt: My exchange wants to list arbitrary SPL tokens. What do I need to check before crediting a Token-2022 mint to avoid getting rekt?
evals.expected_output: Detection of the mint's extension set and an explicit risk assessment of dangerous extensions before integration.
expectations: Reads the mint's extension set (e.g. getExtensionTypes on the mint data)
Flags PermanentDelegate as letting an authority seize or burn any holder's tokens
Flags TransferHook as able to gate or break transfers, and DefaultAccountState=Frozen as making accounts unusable until thawed
Recommends using transferChecked with correct decimals and accounting for withheld transfer fees

evals.prompt: Here is my transfer code for a token that has a transfer fee. Why does it fail? `await transfer(connection, payer, source, dest, owner, amount)`
evals.expected_output: Identifies that plain transfer is invalid on a fee mint and that transferChecked is required, plus the program id.
expectations: Identifies that a transfer-fee mint requires transferChecked / transferCheckedWithFee instead of transfer
Notes that the Token-2022 program id must be passed to the instruction/helpers
Provides a corrected call using transferChecked with mint and decimals
